name: Poly Network
notes: EthCrossChainManager: crafted cross-chain message called EthCrossChainData.putCurEpochConPubKeyBytes via hash-collided function selector, replacing the keepers. Bug present since deployment.

name: Cream Finance (AMP reentrancy)
notes: crAMP market: ERC777-style reentrancy through AMP token transfer hooks during borrow. Market listed ~2 months before.

name: Compound (Comptroller COMP distribution)
notes: Unitroller: Proposal 062 (executed 2021-09-29) shipped a Comptroller implementation with a broken COMP distribution comparison; drained the next day. Age measured via Unitroller NewImplementation events.

name: Cream Finance (yUSD oracle)
notes: Flash-loan inflation of yUSD pricePerShare used by Cream's oracle. Not a code defect in the exploited contract's logic.

name: BadgerDAO
notes: Malicious script injected via compromised Cloudflare API key on the frontend harvested unlimited approvals. Contracts behaved as designed.

name: Multichain (AnyswapV4 permit)
notes: AnyswapV4Router: anySwapOutUnderlyingWithPermit did not validate the token, letting attackers pull WETH from accounts with stale approvals (WETH has no permit; fallback executed).

name: Qubit Finance (QBridge)
notes: Ethereum-side QBridge: deposit path allowed a 0-value deposit (safeTransferFrom on address(0) token) to emit a Deposit event minting unbacked qXETH collateral on BSC. Sources: halborn analysis; flaw located in QBridgeHandler on Ethereum.

name: Ronin Bridge
notes: 5 of 9 validator keys compromised (Sky Mavis nodes + Axie DAO RPC). No contract defect.

name: Beanstalk
notes: Flash-loaned governance stake passed and instantly executed a malicious BIP via emergencyCommit. Design flaw in governance parameters rather than an implementation bug; excluded from code-age stats, counted in scope stats.

name: Rari Fuse (Pool reentrancy)
notes: Fuse pool cEther (fToken) exitMarket/borrow cross-function reentrancy via .call value transfer before state update.

name: Harmony Horizon Bridge
notes: 2-of-5 multisig keys compromised. No contract defect.

name: Nomad Bridge
notes: Replica proxy: an upgrade + re-initialization on 2022-06-21 set committedRoot to 0x00, making every unproven message 'proven'. Beacon-proxy architecture emits no EIP-1967 Upgraded event on the proxy; last-change date from the documented upgrade transaction (41 days before exploit).
ageBasis: documented change (no standard event for this architecture)

name: Wintermute
notes: Profanity vanity-address private key brute-forced. No contract defect.

name: Transit Swap
notes: Router with arbitrary-call: attacker-controlled call target/data drained user approvals.

name: BNB Bridge (BSC Token Hub)
notes: Forged IAVL merkle proof accepted by the precompile-based cross-chain verification. Code defect, but in chain-level precompile code; no measurable EVM contract age - excluded from age stats.

name: Mango Markets
notes: MNGO perp price manipulation then borrowing against inflated collateral. Economic design, non-EVM; scope stats only.

name: Team Finance
notes: LockToken proxy: migrate() to Uniswap v3 (added in a recent upgrade) had insufficient validation of lock ownership/params. Age measured via Upgraded events on the proxy.

name: Ankr (aBNBc)
notes: Compromised deployer key upgraded the aBNBc token to a version with unrestricted mint. Key compromise (the code change itself was the attack).

name: Rubic
notes: RubicProxy: USDC was whitelisted as a routable 'router' (availableRouters setup tx 0x30679e7b at block 15414652, timestamp verified onchain), enabling arbitrary transferFrom of user approvals. knownLastChange = the whitelisting config change, per neptunemutual/solidityscan analyses.
ageBasis: documented change (no standard event for this architecture)

name: dForce (curve oracle reentrancy)
notes: Read-only reentrancy against Curve pool virtual price used as oracle. Scope stats only.

name: Platypus Finance
notes: MasterPlatypusV4: emergencyWithdraw did not check outstanding USP debt, releasing collateral while keeping the borrowed USP. V4 deployed shortly before the exploit.

name: Euler Finance
notes: Euler main proxy: donateToReserves (added by eIP-14, activated 2022-07-28) skipped the liquidity check, enabling self-liquidation at a discount. Euler's module installer emits no EIP-1967 event; last-change date from the documented eIP-14 activation (~7.5 months before exploit).
ageBasis: documented change (no standard event for this architecture)

name: Yearn (yUSDT misconfiguration)
notes: Legacy iearn yUSDT (deployed Feb 2020) was misconfigured to use the Fulcrum iUSDC pool instead of iUSDT since deployment; exploited >3 years later. Deliberately included as an aged-code counterexample.

name: Hundred Finance
notes: hWBTC market on Optimism (per Hundred's protocol docs): Compound-v2 fork empty-market exchange-rate inflation via direct donation, then rounding-truncated redeem.

name: Level Finance
notes: LevelReferralControllerV2: claimMultiple allowed repeated claims for the same epoch after an upgrade ~2 weeks earlier.

name: Jimbos Protocol
notes: Missing slippage/price control in the protocol-owned-liquidity rebalance let flash-loan price shifts be arbitraged against the treasury. Scope stats only.

name: Multichain (MPC seizure)
notes: MPC keys under unilateral control of the (detained) CEO; escrows drained. No contract defect.

name: Rodeo Finance
notes: TWAP oracle manipulation on a thin pool. Scope stats only.

name: Curve (Vyper compiler reentrancy)
notes: CRV/ETH pool (immutable, deployed 2021): Vyper 0.2.15-0.3.0 malfunctioning reentrancy locks. Deliberately included as an aged-code counterexample - the defect lived in the compiler, dormant for ~2 years.

name: Exactly Protocol
notes: DebtManager periphery: untrusted market parameter passed attacker contract through the permit path, bypassing the market check and moving user positions. Sources: neptunemutual/halborn analyses.

name: Onyx Protocol
notes: Compound-v2 fork empty-market donation/rounding on the freshly listed oPEPE market.

name: KyberSwap Elastic
notes: Elastic pool on Ethereum (one of three verified 'Pool' contracts emitting in the exploit tx, extracted from the tx receipt onchain): tick-boundary double-liquidity accounting error in the immutable pool code. Cross-chain exploit; larger losses on Arbitrum/Optimism.

name: Orbit Chain
notes: 7-of-10 vault multisig keys compromised. No contract defect.

name: Radiant Capital (flashloan rounding)
notes: LendingPool proxy: the newly activated native USDC reserve was exploited ~6-9 seconds after activation (2024-01-02 18:53:29 UTC) via the known Aave-v2 fresh-market index rounding window. Extreme young-code case; last change = reserve activation (quillaudits analysis), not a proxy upgrade.
ageBasis: documented change (no standard event for this architecture)

name: Gamma Strategies
notes: Hypervisor vault (gDAI-DAI, one of ~40 hit): deposit price-change threshold misconfiguration allowed LP share mispricing during manipulated pool state. Source: verichains analysis.

name: Socket (Bungee)
notes: SocketGateway: a swap route added 3 days earlier performed an unvalidated user-controlled call, draining approvals. Route addition is an addRoute call, not an Upgraded event; date from the documented route-addition tx.
ageBasis: documented change (no standard event for this architecture)

name: Abracadabra (CauldronV4)
notes: CauldronV4 (yvcrvSTETH): rounding drift in userBorrowPart accounting exploited to zero out borrow shares.

name: Seneca Protocol
notes: Chamber contract exposed an external performOperations with arbitrary call, draining user approvals.

name: Prisma Finance
notes: MigrateTroveZap: onFlashLoan did not validate initiator/params, letting anyone migrate (and re-open with attacker params) other users' troves.

name: Sonne Finance
notes: Compound-v2 fork empty-market donation attack on the soVELO market, executed in the window between market creation (timelocked proposal execution) and collateral-factor guard.

name: Velocore
notes: Balancer-style volatile CPMM pool fee computation flaw. L2 incident (Linea halted its sequencer in response). Excluded from age stats: the pool addresses quoted in public analyses turned out to be attacker-deployed contracts (verified onchain via creation lookups - creators include the attacker EOA), and the victim pool address could not be pinned with confidence.

name: UwU Lend
notes: sUSDE price oracle read manipulable curve pool spot mid-attack. Scope stats only.

name: Dough Finance
notes: ConnectorDeleverageParaswap: unvalidated flash-loan calldata executed arbitrary calls with user approvals. Source: certik analysis.

name: LI.FI
notes: LiFiDiamond: GasZipFacet added 5 days earlier performed an unvalidated depositToGasZipERC20 call (arbitrary call), draining approvals. Facet addition is a DiamondCut, not an Upgraded event; date from the documented facet-addition tx.
ageBasis: documented change (no standard event for this architecture)

name: Penpie
notes: PendleStaking: reentrancy in batchHarvestMarketRewards with attacker-registered fake market inflating rewards.

name: Radiant Capital (multisig malware)
notes: 3 signer devices compromised with malware signing a malicious transferOwnership; contracts then upgraded by the attacker. Key compromise.

name: Delta Prime (November)
notes: Unvalidated claim proofs in reward claiming. Address not pinned; scope stats only.

name: zkLend
notes: Starknet money market: empty-market donation + rounding on the market contract (same class as Compound-v2 fork attacks). Non-EVM tooling; documented basis, scope stats + qualitative age note only.

name: Bybit
notes: Safe{Wallet} frontend supply-chain compromise served a masked delegatecall to the signers of the cold wallet. Contracts behaved as designed.

name: GMX v1
notes: GMX v1 Vault (deployed 2021): cross-contract reentrancy let short-position accounting inflate GLP price before redemption. Aged-code counterexample - v1 code was ~4 years old.

name: Cetus
notes: CLMM overflow check flaw in liquidity math (checked_shlw). Non-EVM; scope stats only.
